reviews.title: Tried and True SSHD
reviews.comment: I know, I know... why an SSHD with you could use an SSD or NvME drive? Well some older systems work great with these drives (think consoles and such). That said - this bad boy has been in my PS3 (and at one time PS4) running like a CHAMP! Can't go wrong with them for the storage capacity, ability, and dependability!
reviews.author: Brad A.

reviews.title: Perfect Upgrade for a Molasses-Grade laptop
reviews.comment: ...where you know that the hard drive is the only bottleneck in the system. However if your previous hard drive was a sluggish 5400rpm wd blue, this is going to be a pitch perfect upgrade for your computer! After installing this hard drive in my laptop and giving it a fresh install of Windows 10, it's been flying since! Keep in mind, we're talking an i7-740qm+4GB of DDR3. Seriosuly shouldn't be able to handle windows 10 but it does, with infinite grace. Forget SSD's, SSHD's are the best cheap upgrade you can make on your old computer.
